description:
User authorized adding the broader gap identified in zaq-vfx. Implement in ProviderLive and provider_live.html.heex.
Functional specification: preserve distinct capability error at mount and both refresh_provider_page paths. Reuse existing component error? input. Retry capability query only on modal opening after failure; preserve cached success, config/form/grant/folder state, and provider request semantics. Existing full refresh operations must reset the error flag on success and set it on failure.
Tests before implementation: new synchronous ConnCase data-source regression tests using disk and available remote providers with no connector, plus direct real-boundary callback coverage of refresh-after-failure/recovery as appropriate. Cover repeated failure, recovery, no refetch after success, and unchanged draft/folder state. Add property test for cache/state preservation using valid snapshot maps. No existing tests are changed.
Mocking: existing isolated missing-bridge fixture and real NodeRouter/Channels/Bridge; no remote file calls are needed for unconfigured providers. Global registration change limited to synchronous tests with on_exit restoration.
Action reuse assessment: reuse existing dispatch_channel_capability_snapshot/1, Channels.Api and Bridge normalization; extend local state loading around existing query and shared modal. Input/output provider contract unchanged, read-only retry, no new Action or agent exposure. This is UI lifecycle handling only.
Module context: ProviderLive owns provider configuration UI and caches folder/grant state in socket; mount and two private refresh paths currently reduce errors to empty maps. Retry must not call whole-page refresh because it clears drafts/modals. Scope excludes underlying ingestion/storage operations.
Documentation: update shared contract in docs/services/channels.md following docs/documentation.md; retain one owner for common behavior.
Validation: mix q, new LiveView tests and existing provider_live_test.exs; then combined modal suite. Existing tests remain intact. New browser authoring unnecessary for this bounded server event/render correction. E2E runtime unavailable (missing Playwright); no install authorized. Preserve explicit stop on mix precommit and record outstanding final gates on epic.

comments.text: Completed the authorized expanded capability-modal recovery. All five shared component callers now pass error?. ChannelsLive covers generic communication providers; ProviderLive uses one private loader for mount, modal retries and both connector refresh paths. Retries preserve unrelated state and cache successful snapshots including empty results. New tests reproduced failures before fixes and now cover Mattermost, Discord, Telegram, Disk, Google Drive and SharePoint, a later outage after cached success, state-preservation properties, and both data-source refresh paths. The new save test needed a valid base-URL fixture to exercise its intended path; no existing test behavior was changed. Final mix q passed; combined 11-file suite passed 324 checks (3 properties, 321 tests); git diff --check clean. Shared behavior documented under Bridge Behaviour in docs/services/channels.md. No new Action, service contract, provider selection change, commit, push or GitHub comment. Browser E2E remains unavailable because Playwright is missing; coverage and explicitly stopped mix precommit remain epic-level final gates.

title: [zaq-vfx.6] Extend capability recovery to data-source provider pages
